## Why

Two live legs stopped fail-closed on the same contradiction 2026-10-14:
`ops/iam_identities.toml` declares a **100-job** fleet (`expected_job_count`),
production holds **88**. The missing twelve are exactly the ten
`sig-ingest-r11-*` wave batches and the two `sig-ingest-*-tribal-*`
ADR-185 screened-lane rows declared in `ops/cadence.toml` — jobs the
recorded ordering never created. The operator picked the scoped bridge:
seed exactly those twelve with their triggers paused, then
`P34.42b-live-2` migrates the whole 100-job fleet to `sig-ingest-rt`,
then `P35.1a-live-2` retries the scheduler-of-record leg with
`--apply --paused`.

## What ships

- **`ops/gcp/seed-declared-jobs.sh`** — the one authorized seed path.
  `--check` (default) plans offline with no ADC/network; `--apply` is
  window-gated (weekday 14:00–20:00Z only, else exit 42) and performs
  **exactly** the contract's 36 mutations: per row, absence re-check →
  job create on the contract-pinned digest
  (`…sig-api@sha256:6ad5477d…f5`) under the **project default compute
  SA** labelled `runtime-identity=temporary-default-compute` →
  `roles/run.invoker` for the existing `sig-scheduler` → trigger create
  → immediate `pause` → `PAUSED` read-back. A pre-existing target
  refuses; a pause failure rolls back only this leg's creations
  (`created.txt` replay: triggers → bindings → jobs;
  `--apply rollback` replays it on demand). Never executes a job, never
  resumes a trigger, creates no SA, never calls `scheduled-ops.sh`.
- **`tests/ops/test_seed_declared_jobs.py`** — 28 offline tests over a
  fake-`gcloud` stub: closed-set closure, cadence-drift refusal, digest
  enforcement, temporary-SA command+label, mutation ordering,
  existing-target refusal, pause-failure rollback scoping, exit-42
  queueing, evidence capture, no-execute/no-resume, exact 12×4 counts.
- **`ops/gcp/config.sh` + `ops/gcp/README.md` +
  `tests/ops/test_gcp_iac.py`** — the state-dir block, the runbook row,
  and syntax/exec/pinned-digest sweep coverage.
- **`docs/build/tools/return_pass.py`** — `TICKET_ID_RE` accepts
  digit-suffixed ids (`P35.1a1`) so the queued leg row sorts inside its
  family (`P35.1a` < `P35.1a1` < `P35.1b`, test-pinned).
- **Evidence** — `docs/build/reports/p35.1a1-seed-declared-jobs/`:
  honest QUEUED README + the committed `--check` plan (36 mutations on
  the pinned digest, sha256 sidecars).

## What this does NOT do

No service-account creation, no existing job/trigger/identity update, no
`gcloud run jobs execute` / `scheduler jobs run` / `resume`, no
`services enable`, no `ingestion_permitted` flip, no P35.11 wave leg, no
`main` operation. The twelve seeded jobs' interim
`default-compute`-vs-`sig-ingest-rt` drift is expected state owned by
`P34.42b-live-2` — labelled, never hidden.
